scenes.text_en: Meet Goalie, an AI financial agent inside your banking app. Your goals live as subcards under your main card.

When your salary arrives, Goalie splits it for you. Rent is reserved first, then your goals by priority, and the rest stays on your main card. Only salary counts, so a transfer from family never changes the plan.

Try to spend from a goal on the cinema, and Goalie steps in. It shows what it would cost in days and bonus, and suggests waiting until tomorrow. A pharmacy purchase passes instantly, because the category is decided by code, not by what you type.
Tell the agent your goal in plain words. It picks the percent from your worst annual salary, so the plan holds even in a bad year.
Ask about a loan, and it ranks the demo offers by total cost, shows how each one delays your goals, and compares them with simply saving. Nothing is applied without your confirmation.
Goalie: code calculates, AI explains, you decide.
